items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This year I did the “Piano Jazz” with Michel Legrand.

ctx.x: Today is May 26th, nineteen-hundred and ninety-eight, and this is the Smithsonian Oral History Program for Jazz Masters, part two or volume two of the interview with the grande dame of jazz, Ms. Marian McPartland. My name is James Williams

You better take that off there. [laughter] The one I like much better is when I was down in . . . This year I did the “Piano Jazz” with Michel Legrand. I was in Florida. One of these weekly papers called me “the coolest woman in jazz.” That was the
headline. I thought that was neat. I don’t mind that. But all those other things. Those other epithets. Queen of Jazz.
